submitted.rationale: XRD shows the same FTO substrate peaks at every point (Q ≈ 1.88, 2.37, 2.65, 3.56), plus extra peaks that depend on composition. Point 22 (Fe-rich) has extra peaks that look like a spinel or hematite-type Fe oxide, the phases expected to absorb light at 2.06 eV. Point 22 gave 9e-8 A, nine times more than the Fe-V point 126 (1e-8 A), so more V seems to lower the photocurrent. Point 81 (similar Fe-rich, low V) matched 22 at 9e-8 A. I chose 22 because it has the most Fe.

rejected.reason: Measured 1e-8 A. Its higher V content (Fe-V phase at Q≈1.93) goes with a much lower photocurrent.
Measured 9e-8 A, tied with 22. It has less Fe, so 22 is kept.
XRD shows a mix of vanadate/V-oxide phases, and the Fe→V trend in the measurements points down.
XRD shows NiO, which has a wide band gap (~3.5 eV) and should not absorb 2.06 eV light.
